clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge's Mystic Ward, faith and arcane study share the city's quieter quarter. Pale blue banners mark its halls, and the Hall of Mysteries gathers priests, paladins, and mages beneath stone arches.

The Mystic Ward carries Ironforge's quieter pursuits of faith and learning. Pale blue banners mark the quarter between the Commons, the Forlorn Cavern, and the Great Forge. Shops such as The Fighting Wizard and Maeva's Mystical Apparel supply scholars and spellweavers with regalia, scrolls, and alchemical reagents. At the Hall of Mysteries, followers of the Holy Light and practitioners of arcane magic find guidance in wielding powers unseen in defense of the Alliance.
